name: Therm-a-Rest NeoAir XTherm NXT insulated sleeping pad
summary: Manufacturer-documented winter ground insulation with a 7.3 R-value. Understand sleep-system fit, inflatable-pad limits and the unverified Canadian retailer variant.
description: Ground insulation deserves its own place in a winter kit. A pad resists heat loss beneath your body, while a suitable sleeping bag and shelter address other parts of the system. The NeoAir XTherm NXT is an inflatable option; its usefulness depends on fit, condition and a realistic backup plan. This informational profile covers the documented model family, not a verified Amazon size or package.
